title: 3 Forgotten Pokémon Movies That Are Secretly Awesome
content: Pokémon is one of the most beloved franchises of all time, known for its anime, movies, card games, video games, manga, and more. For many 1990s kids, the series is a nostalgic childhood memory as it takes the viewers into a fantasy world full of unique creatures known as Pokémon .
author: ComicBook

title: Gacha Girls Corps Anime Casts Ai Kayano, Rie Kugimiya
content: The staff for the anime of author Chinkururi and illustrator Yasutaka Isegawa 's Gacha Girls Corps ( Gacha o Mawashite Nakama o Fuyasu: Saikyō no Bishōjo Gundan o Tsukuriagero ) light novel series announced two more cast members on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Just Made a Huge Change to Its Original Finale & Shocks With Big Death
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has entered truly uncharted territory with its newest episode as it has made a huge change to how the manga’s final arc originally played out, and it’s shocked even further with a big death.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s One Piece Season 3 Expands Alabasta With Major Cast Additions
content: One Piece is hard at work on bringing its third season of the live-action series to Netflix next year, and it’s filling out more of its new cast with some major new additions. One Piece is gearing up to have a massive year in 2027 with more of the TV anime, a reboot series, a new feature film release and more on the…

title: Comikey to Add Several Shōjo Manga from Hakusensha's Catalogue Digitally
content: Comikey announced on August 17 it will release several shōjo manga titles from Hakusensha 's catalogue in English digitally. The first announced title is sora 's Crashout Schoolgirl and Degen Teacher ( Tsuiraku JK to Haijin Kyōshi ) and the first seven chapters are available to read now.
author: ANN

title: 37 Years Later, Legendary Sports Series Is Getting Its First-Ever U.S. Release
content: Sports anime such as Haikyu and Blue Lock have been on the rise in recent years, but several classics came before them to pave the path for the genre’s success. Fans often love the underdog trope in sports series where the protagonist, who everyone underestimates, gets to shine due to his grit and dedication.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Confirms 2 New Movies & Is Making History With Biggest Arc Yet
content: One Piece has officially announced that it’s now working on two new feature film releases for the near future, and the first of these movies is making history for the franchise when it adapts one of the biggest events in Eiichiro Oda’s original manga yet.
author: ComicBook

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Creditless Ending Scene Video From Episode 5
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 revealed the non-credit ending video from Episode 5 “DEFEND YOU.” The anime previously revealed Ichigo’s new Blood Chains form that was also introduced in the episode, which was mostly anime-original.
author: Anime Corner

title: Midori Amagaeru, Tsukasa Kyoka's 'Online - The Comic' Manga Ends
content: Manga Box published the 255th and final chapter of Midori Amagaeru and Tsukasa Kyoka 's Online: The Comic manga on August 14. Amagaeru shared an illustration celebrating the end of the manga. The manga launched on DeNA 's MangaBox app in 2013.
author: ANN

title: 1 Year Later, Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Solo Leveling’s Breakout Replacement
content: Solo Leveling confirmed an anime sequel in July this year, more than a year after the second season finale. The series’ first feature-length film will follow the story after the fan-favorite Jeju Island Arc. However, the anime has yet to confirm a release window.
author: ComicBook
